register.labelZh: STICK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: stick around、stick at、stick to 和 stick with 可以分別表示留在附近、堅持嘗試、遵守規則或繼續某個選擇。；stick by、stick together 和 stick up for 可以表示支持某人、保持團結,以及為某人或某個想法辯護。；把物件放入口袋、黏上標籤、開水煲、黏合不同部分或把報告放在桌上時,都可以使用 STICK 表達。；stick out、stick up 和 stick through 可以描述某物十分顯眼,或向某個方向突出。
register.summaryEn: Stick around, stick at, stick to and stick with distinguish staying nearby, continuing despite difficulty, following a rule and continuing with a choice. Stick by, stick together and stick up for describe supporting someone, remaining united and defending a person or idea. Use STICK expressions when putting things in a pocket, attaching a label, switching on the kettle, joining pieces or placing a report on a desk. Stick out, stick up and stick through describe something noticeable or projecting in a particular direction.

register.formalEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the STICK expression that gives the same meaning.

fixedVariable.fixedZh: 閱讀整句,選出意思相同的 STICK 片語動詞。
fixedVariable.fixedEn: Read the whole sentence and choose the STICK expression that gives the same meaning.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；參考表列出的是核心表達。其他字詞可以補充時間、地點、方法或原因,但不會自動成為固定表達的一部分。；使用 it、him、her 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。；有些表達看來相似,但意思不同。stick out 可以表示「顯眼」或「向外突出」;stick up 則可以表示「向上突出」、「張貼」、「舉起」或「行劫」。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. The reference bank shows the core expression. Extra words may add a time, place, method or reason, but they are not automatically part of the fixed expression: stick around stick around after class stick something down stick something down with tape With it, him, her or them, place the word as shown: stick it back stick it down stick it in stick it on stick it out stick them together stick it up Some expressions look alike but have different meanings. Stick out can mean “be noticeable” or “project outwards”; stick up can mean “point upwards”, “display”, “raise” or “rob”.
